messages.subject: how to fix threshold (ordinal variable)
parts:
Hi,

I hope to fix threshold(s) for an ordinal variable. In Mplus I used this format: (this is a part of MODEL structure)
 MODEL:
   f by x1  @0.953 ;
   f by x2  @1.676;
   f *;
   [f *]; 
   [x1$1  @ -4.606] ;
   [x1$2  @ -2.076] ;
      



I am wondering how to fix thresholds (as constants) in lavaan.

Thank you so much for your advice!!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: how to fix threshold (ordinal variable)
parts: I am wondering how to fix thresholds (as constants) in lavaan.

See the ?model.syntax help page.

MODEL <- '
  f =~ 0.953*x1 + 1.676*x2   # fixed loadings
  f ~~ NA*f                  # free variances
  f ~  NA*1                  # free mean
  x1 | -4.606*t1 + -2.076*t2 # fixed thresholds
  x2 |     NA*t1 +     NA*t2 # free thresholds (intended?)
'

Hopefully you understand all the implications of your model, and how many statistically equivalent specifications there can be that represent different ideas about why your x1-by-x2 frequency tables follows its observed pattern.

https://doi.org/10.1007/s11336-016-9506-0

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
